title: Deliver run gates to Telegram through the RunRoom pending store
description: The return arrow: a cloud run must be able to reach its human. When the orchestrator parks a question or an approval gate, it lands in the RunRoom pending store and is delivered on the channel the submission chose, reusing the existing internal/operator/telegram machinery and its paired-operator rule. Answering from the phone resolves it through the DO; tk answer from a terminal resolves the same entry, first-wins, losers told who answered (D5). Completion reports land on the same chat, threading the original message. Human verdicts keep human provenance: the --from human attestation rule and the verdict guard apply unchanged, so an approval delivered this way is still a human verdict.
acceptance_criteria: A gate parked by a cloud run reaches Telegram and blocks the run; answering from Telegram resumes it; answering the same gate from tk answer resolves it and the other surface reports already-answered; the resulting verdict carries human provenance and passes the verdict guard; an unpaired sender is dropped at the transport.
